purpose: Teach: 精神病/思索/低温/男系/蛋白/環状/中等/疑似

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、精神病患者のケアを医療チームで丁寧に提供します
lines.en: Ren, we provide careful psychiatric care as a medical team.
lines.style: Even, assured, clinical but not cold. Speaks with the quiet authority of someone who has seen much. Steady eye contact. Each phrase lands with deliberate care.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、診断には深い思索が必要だと医療チームで認識します
lines.en: Yes—we recognize that diagnosis requires deep reflection across our entire team.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause after the affirmation. Measured pace. Shoulders squared. Not defensive, but emphasizing the weight of the work. Generous, not perfunctory.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、検体の低温保存を医療チームで徹底します
lines.en: Ren, our team maintains meticulous temperature control for all specimens.
lines.style: Calm, methodical. The certainty of someone describing protocol they have tested. Slight forward lean, as if walking him through it. No flourish, only precision.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 男系遺伝病の研究を、貴院、進められてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital does seem to be advancing research on sex-linked genetic disorders, Doctor.
lines.style: Quiet intellectual curiosity. Not quite a question, more an observation he's turning over. Respectful lilt at the end. The tone of someone learning and genuinely noticing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者の蛋白尿を医療チームで日々確認します
lines.en: Yes—we monitor proteinuria in each patient daily without exception.
lines.style: Steady, attentive rhythm. The voice of routine elevated to care. Slight emphasis on 'daily,' conveying vigilance without alarm. Present, not tired.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、環状の心電図モニターを医療チームで観察します
lines.en: Yes—our team observes continuous cardiac monitoring with close attention.
lines.style: Even delivery. Clinical precision without distance. Slight breath between clauses. The voice of someone who has learned that small details save lives. Grounded.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 中等度の合併症を、貴院、適切に管理されますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital certainly seems to manage moderate complications with real skill, Doctor.
lines.style: Genuine admiration underneath. Quiet respect. The tone of someone noticing something true and saying it plainly. Not flattery—observation. Slight warmth in the close.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、疑似症例の鑑別を医療チームで丁寧におこないます
lines.en: Yes—we perform differential diagnosis for atypical cases with deliberate care.
lines.style: Unhurried, methodical. The assurance of thorough work. Slight closure on the final word, as if closing a file. Present, committed, not rushed. The voice of someone who will not skip the hard part.
